info.name: E-commerce Management API (v1)
info.description:
Products & Inventory, Orders and Sales Analytics.

1. Set `base_url` (default http://localhost:8000/api/v1).
2. Run **Auth → Login (Admin)**; the token is stored automatically in `token`.
3. Requests that create resources store their ids in `category_id`, `product_id`, `variant_id` and `order_id`.

The collection is ordered so it can be run top-to-bottom with the Collection Runner (or `npx newman run`) against freshly seeded data. Destructive requests and the staff permission checks are in the final **Cleanup & permissions** folder.

Demo users: admin@example.com / password, staff@example.com / password.

request.description: Returns a Sanctum bearer token (saved to {{token}}).
To upload a thumbnail send multipart/form-data with a `thumbnail` image file.
For thumbnail upload use POST with multipart/form-data and `_method=PUT`. Send `remove_thumbnail=true` to clear it.
Attributes are free-form key/value pairs. Opening stock is recorded as an "initial" inventory movement.
stock_quantity cannot be changed here; use adjust-stock.
For type=adjustment, quantity is the new absolute stock level.

item.name: Adjust stock: below zero is rejected (409)

request.description: Prices are taken from the catalogue. Stock is checked but only deducted on confirmation.
Always 200; check data.results for each order.
Soft delete. 409 if the variant is part of an open order.
Soft delete. 409 if the product is part of open orders.
Staff can view catalogue/inventory and manage orders, but cannot change products, adjust stock or issue refunds.
